result.topic_en: Bounds and maximum order for the counting function Q_2(N) of sums of two squares related to the divisor function, followed by the generating function and Dirichlet series for the number of representations of N by m^2+mn+n^2.
result.transcription:
Add MS a 94 18(34) (34) (70)
(280). $\{3+\gamma-2\log\pi+4\log\Gamma(\tfrac34)\}\sqrt{x} \geq R_1(x)(\log x)^2 \geq \{1-\gamma+2\log\pi-4\log\Gamma(\tfrac34)\}\sqrt{x}$
It can easily be verified that
(281) $\begin{cases} 3+\gamma-2\log\pi+4\log\Gamma(\tfrac34) = 2.101 \\ 1-\gamma+2\log\pi-4\log\Gamma(\tfrac34) = 1.899, \end{cases}$
approximately.
Proceeding as in §43 we can show that the maxi-
-mum order of $Q_2(N)$ is
(282) $2^{\frac12 Li(2\log N)+\phi(N)}$,
where $\phi(N) = \frac{\log(\frac32)}{2\log 2} Li\left\{\tfrac32(\log N)^{\frac{\log(3/2)}{\log 2}}\right\} - \frac{3(\log N)^{\frac{\log(3/2)}{\log 2}}}{4\log(2\log N)}$
$- R_1(2\log N) + O\left\{\frac{\sqrt{(\log N)}}{(\log\log N)^3}\right\}$.
55. Let $\bar{Q}_2(N)$ denote the number of ways in which
$N$ can be expressed as $m^2+mn+n^2$. Let us agree to
consider $m^2+mn+n^2$ as two ways if $m$ and $n$ are un-
equal, and as one way if they are equal or one of them
is zero. Then it can be shown that
(283) $\tfrac12(1+2q^{\frac14}+2q^{\frac44}+2q^{\frac94}+\cdots)(1+2q^{\frac34}+2q^{\frac{12}{4}}+2q^{\frac{27}{4}}+\cdots)$
$+\tfrac12(1-2q^{\frac14}+2q^{\frac44}-2q^{\frac94}+\cdots)(1-2q^{\frac34}+2q^{\frac{12}{4}}-2q^{\frac{27}{4}}+\cdots)$
$=1+6\left(\frac{q}{1-q}-\frac{q^2}{1-q^2}+\frac{q^4}{1-q^4}-\frac{q^5}{1-q^5}+\cdots\right)$
$=1+6\{\bar{Q}_2(1)q+\bar{Q}_2(2)q^2+\bar{Q}_2(3)q^3+\cdots\}$,
where 1, 2, 4, 5, ... are the natural numbers without
the multiples of 3. From this it follows that
(284) $\zeta(s)\zeta_2(s) = 1^{-s}\bar{Q}_2(1)+2^{-s}\bar{Q}_2(2)+3^{-s}\bar{Q}_2(3)+\cdots$

methods.what: Upper and lower bounds for R_1(x)(log x)^2 in terms of sqrt(x) with constants involving gamma, pi and Gamma(3/4)
Numerical values of the two constants
Maximum order of Q_2(N), with explicit correction term phi(N)
Theta-function identity giving the generating function of representations by m^2+mn+n^2 as a Lambert series over integers prime to 3
Dirichlet series for bar Q_2(N) as product zeta(s) zeta_2(s)
